response.text: {"messages":[{"role":"customer","text":"Hello! Good morning. Could I place an order for pickup, please?"},{"role":"business","text":"Good morning! Of course, what can I get started for you?"},{"role":"customer","text":"I'll have my usual breakfast sandwich — same as last time."},{"role":"business","text":"Happy to! Can you remind me which sandwich that was, and how many you'd like?"},{"role":"customer","text":"It's the Breakfast Sandwich, on an English muffin. I'll take three of them, and please add avocado to each one."},{"role":"business","text":"Got it — three Breakfast Sandwiches with avocado. Anything else?"},{"role":"customer","text":"Yes. Three Bagels, cinnamon raisin. And by the way, is the hot chocolate made with whole milk by default?"},{"role":"business","text":"It is — our Hot Chocolate comes with whole milk and whipped cream, and you can swap the milk if you'd like. So that's three cinnamon raisin Bagels. Anything else?"},{"role":"customer","text":"No hot chocolate today, thank you. Two Croissants with butter, please. I'll pick everything up, and I'm paying cash — could you make change for a fifty?"},{"role":"business","text":"Sure thing — two Croissants with butter, and we can break a fifty for you. Can I get a name and when you'd like it ready?"},{"role":"customer","text":"Leah, and as soon as possible, please."}]}
